release_notes.en:
### What's New in ArgonMusic v3.2.9

• **Android OEM & Play Protect Security Hardening**: Removed `REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES`, `MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE`, and `requestLegacyExternalStorage`, eliminating security risk warnings during installation on Vivo, Oppo, Xiaomi, and other Android devices.
• **Network, Backup & FileProvider Hardening**: Enforced `usesCleartextTraffic=false` (loopback-only local proxy exception), disabled cloud/ADB backup extraction (`allowBackup=false`), and scoped FileProvider paths strictly to `cache-path`.
• **Safe HTTPS Browser Update Delegation**: Removed in-app APK dropper code paths (`installApk`) and delegated Android update downloads directly to the verified system browser over HTTPS.
• **Release Packaging Hygiene**: Excluded VCS metadata, dependency info blocks, and `DebugProbesKt.bin` from release APKs with verified V1+V2+V3 release signing.
